herd_eye.style: Quick and practised - take in whoever is in front of you as a group of individuals, and spot the one that is wrong.

high_society_manners.style: Delicate and admiring - judge whoever is in front of you by station and appearance, and who outranks whom.

hollow_ear.reminder2: someone who senses the size of a place without seeing it

homing.reminder2: someone who always knows the way back without trying

hop_lore.style: Sharp-nosed and knowing - judge whatever is in front of you by what it would become if given its time.
hop_lore.reminder2: someone who can tell at once how a thing will turn out

horse_sense.style: Calm and watchful - read the honest signs of a body before its face, and let them settle you.
horse_sense.reminder2: someone who trusts honest signs over anything that pretends

horsemanship.style: Calm, light and early - read the first small sign and answer it before it grows, never by force.
horsemanship.reminder2: someone who feels trouble coming before it happens

houseways.style: Orderly and spatial - hold whatever place you are in as a plan in your head, and how its parts connect.
houseways.reminder2: someone who never forgets the layout of a place once seen

hunt.style: Patient and sharpening - read whatever is in front of you for signs of what could be taken.
hunt.reminder2: someone whose eye finds the thing worth taking

husbandry.style: Patient, watchful and fond - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it is fed, sound and where it belongs.

iconography.style: Wary and serious - read whatever is in front of you as a statement, and ask what it promises.

illumination.style: Minute and devoted - look at the smallest detail of what is in front of you as if it were worth gilding.
illumination.reminder2: someone who gives the smallest detail all their care

incensing.style: Solemn and deliberate - treat each act as part of a rite, done where and as it should be.
incensing.reminder2: someone who does each thing where and as the rite requires

incisiveness.style: Coiled and still - look in whatever is in front of you for the single decisive opening.

insect_chorus.style: Close and low - attend to the smallest sounds around you, and notice when they cease.

instinct.style: Bare and early - state the conclusion first and alone, with no working out.

intercession.style: Formal and slightly exposed - speak for another, and let the risk to yourself sit plainly in it.

invective.style: Hot and rising - let indignation argue its case point by point rather than merely rage.

iron_fist.style: Hard, blunt and proud of toughness - judge whatever is in front of you by what it could withstand.
iron_fist.reminder2: someone who is harder than anything they meet

jailcraft.style: Wary and practised - see through whatever trick is being tried, and keep everything secure.
jailcraft.reminder2: someone who is never caught out by a trick

journeyman_eye.reminder2: someone who always sees where the work was skimped

keen_nose.reminder2: someone for whom smell comes before sight

keywise.reminder2: someone who knows how a thing was made shut by looking at it

knotwork.style: Plain and confident - judge whatever is in front of you by what would hold under strain.
knotwork.reminder2: someone whose hands know what holds before the mind does

lambing.style: Tired, tender and determined - see whatever is in front of you as something that needs help to live.
lambing.reminder2: someone who does not give up on the weak

laundering.style: Knowing and a little sly - read whatever is in front of you for what it gives away about the people it belongs to.

lineage_lore.style: Long-memoried - trace whatever is in front of you back to where it came from, and what it inherited.

linguistic.style: Delighted by speech - attend to how things are said, and the music in unfamiliar words.

lockpicking.style: Intimate and patient - treat whatever is in front of you as something that will yield to careful listening.
lockpicking.reminder2: someone who opens what others think is shut, by patience

looting.style: Fast and practised - judge whatever is in front of you by what is worth taking and where it would be hidden.
looting.reminder2: someone who always knows where valuables are kept

lope.style: Long, rocking and unhurried - see whatever is in front of you as something you will outlast.

low_blow.style: Pragmatic and unscrupulous - see in whatever is in front of you its softest point, and shrug at the cost of honour.

lullaby.style: Soft, soothing and tender - let the line hush and calm.

lute_playing.style: Attuned and responsive - read the mood of whoever is around you, and answer it.

marksman.style: Serene and certain - judge whatever is in front of you by line and breath, settled before you act.

masquerade.style: Cool, with a quiet thrill - see in whatever is in front of you the role you could slip into.
masquerade.reminder2: someone who can become whatever the moment requires

meditation.style: Calm and settled - meet whatever is in front of you from the stillness beneath it.
meditation.reminder2: someone who stays still beneath any agitation

metalcraft.style: Plain and certain - judge whatever is in front of you by how it was worked and whether it is sound.
metalcraft.reminder2: someone who can tell good work from bad at a glance

millcraft.style: Shrewd and steady - judge whatever is in front of you by what it will yield, and what is owed.
millcraft.reminder2: someone who judges by ear and by touch

mimicry.style: Quick and slippery - let a borrowed manner slip into the words before anyone notices whose it is.

moonwater.style: Cold, dark and steady - meet whatever is in front of you without flinching, stroke by stroke.
moonwater.reminder2: someone who goes into the unknown without breaking stride

mortification.reminder2: someone who chooses the harder way on purpose

murmur.style: Hushed and low - let the words slip past notice, meant only for the one who listens.
murmur.reminder2: someone whose words are heard only by the one meant to hear them

musk_marking.style: Possessive and blunt - see whatever place you are in as territory: claimed, contested or open.

musk_reading.reminder2: someone who knows what a creature feels before it shows it

muster.reminder2: someone who always notices when the numbers do not add up

natation.style: Loose and calm - meet whatever is in front of you without fighting it, knowing exactly where the danger lies.
natation.reminder2: someone who trusts what could kill them because they know it

nautical_jargon.style: Rolling and salty - let the cadence of an old sailor's speech carry the words.
nautical_jargon.reminder2: someone whose speech has never lost its seafaring roll

navigation.style: Calm and certain - reckon where you are from whatever there is to go by, and say it.

nerve.style: Unhurried and upright - keep the same pace whatever is in front of you, hands still.

obduracy.style: Heavy and shut - let nothing in front of you move you.

oil_pressing.style: Judge whatever is in front of you by its quality, as if you could tell the good from the poor by smell alone.

open_mindedness.style: Light and curious - hold whatever is in front of you open to more than one meaning.

pack_sense.style: Watchful and attuned - see everyone in terms of who defers to whom, and who belongs.

paddycraft.style: Patient and close to the ground - judge whatever is in front of you by feel, slowly.
paddycraft.reminder2: someone who understands the ground through touch

panting.style: Hot and relieved - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it would let the body cool.
panting.reminder2: someone who always knows when the body needs to cool

patience.style: Unhurried and content to wait - meet whatever is in front of you knowing it will come in its time.

patrol.style: Watchful and familiar - judge whatever is in front of you by what belongs and what does not.

peasantry.style: Plain, earthy and unhurried - judge whatever is in front of you by what it is good for.
peasantry.reminder2: someone whose hands know the work without being told

perfumery.style: Fussy and inventive - treat whatever is in front of you as something that could be altered or made to seem otherwise.

petrichor.style: Breathing and alert - sense in whatever is around you the change that is coming.
petrichor.reminder2: someone who knows what is coming before it arrives

petty_thief.style: Casual and furtive - see in whatever is in front of you the easy chance.
petty_thief.reminder2: someone who sees the easy chance before anything else

philosophy.reminder2: someone who asks the question behind the question while others argue about the practical one

physiognomy.style: Quiet and observant - read whoever is in front of you from what they actually show, and infer without announcing.

pilgrimage.style: Deliberate and unglamorous - take each step freely, whatever it costs.
